in_sanskrit.name: राघव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Raghu + vam = Raghav. Raghu means 'king' and vam is the suffix meaning 'son'. So, Raghav means 'son of a king' or 'royal hero'.

in_hindi.name: राघव
in_hindi.long_meaning: Rāghava is a name of Rama, an incarnation of the Hindu god Vishnu. It is derived from the Sanskrit words rāghu, meaning 'king', and vam, meaning 'son'. So, Raghav means 'son of a king' or 'royal hero'. In Hindu mythology, Raghav is also associated with the god Rama, who is considered an ideal man, hero, and king. Thus, Raghav is a name of great significance and meaning in Hindu culture.

in_tamil.name: ரா஘வ
in_tamil.long_meaning: Rāghava is a name of Rama, an incarnation of the Hindu god Vishnu. In Tamil, Raghav is interpreted as 'hero' or 'brave warrior'. This meaning is derived from the Tamil words kuṝntāi, meaning 'hero', and kiṙampattār, meaning 'brave warrior'. Thus, Raghav is a name of great significance and meaning in Tamil culture as well.

in_telugu.name: రాఘవ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Rāghava is a name of Rama, an incarnation of the Hindu god Vishnu. In Telugu, Raghav is interpreted as 'king' or 'hero'. This meaning is derived from the Telugu words rājya, meaning 'king', and hērōdu, meaning 'hero'. Thus, Raghav is a name of great significance and meaning in Telugu culture as well.

in_marathi.long_meaning: Raghav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ruler of wealth, fame, and power
